summary: LiveOne filed an 8-K disclosing a Shares Issuance Agreement with Music Story SAS, issuing 70,000 shares at $7.50 per share as payment for outstanding and prepaid license fees under a metadata agreement. The license term extends to February 2028. Shares will be sold under an existing shelf registration with no cash proceeds to LiveOne. Sale restrictions cap volume at 3.5% of average daily trading volume. This is a routine equity issuance for service settlement, not a special situation.
